acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: A 22-year-old woman has been going to protest in Hong Kong for more than four months. She’s got packing her bag for a protest down to a science. She shows host Ira Glass and producer Emanuele Berry what’s inside.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: A bunch of 22-year-olds from Hong Kong explain why they are cursed and what that means for their and Hong Kong’s future.
acts.title: The Cursed Generation

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Ira and Emanuele go to a protest and get tear gassed in front of a Ruth's Chris Steakhouse.
acts.title: The Fight

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Producer Emanuele Berry has a day at the mall unlike any other.
acts.title: Uncivil Disobedience

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: A protestor who thinks the Hong Kong police are terrible has a chat with his dad — a police officer. Alan Yu reports.
acts.title: Good Cop, Dad Cop

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: Producer Diane Wu goes to a party. A Chinese flag party.
acts.title: A Slow Boat to China

acts.label: Act Six
acts.desc: The 22-year-old woman from the beginning of the show catches up with producer Diane Wu. Things are different.
acts.title: Two Weeks Later
